ontology.note: The semantic contract belongs to the ruleset, which declares its own output vocabulary and basis; do not infer one from this widget.

changes.description: A record from a table is named in the run's sentence by its declared key, or else by the first key column that tells every row apart, rather than by every key value joined: Hagelloch's serial interval had named four records as everything they held (experiment 208).

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists, and the Validation Lab checks this widget exhaustively rather than by sample -- check 23 enumerates the complete input space of all three bundled rulesets, 46 cells, reproducing every conclusion with an independent decision table and verifying the emitted receipt. That is evidence about the rulesets and about this widget's four stages; it does not certify the widget independently, and it says nothing about whether any threshold is right. 0.12.0: tests/seven-one-seven.browser.mjs (four cases by hand: 9 and -1 days, NoVerdict where onset or response is missing); Chromium. Experiment 207: tests/data-issues.test.mjs, tests/seven-one-seven-ontology.test.mjs, tests/ruleset-example.test.mjs. 0.13.0: tests/band-rules.test.mjs (labels, conditions, every age in exactly one band, refusals). 0.13.1: scripts/sentence-numbers.mjs finds every number in each step's sentence among its results, across every worked example; Validation Lab check 49 recomputes MERS's 7-1-7 verdicts from the source files.
